basic_info.description: Get the best of old and new world influence with this meticulously crafted 1884 Victorian condo. The bespoke property was designed by an architect as a personal residence; bringing high-end detail and finishes together with period charm. The home offers natural light, high ceilings and airy interiors with European white oak floors, integrated lighting and a set of oversized Fleetwood sliders leading to a private rooftop deck with GGB bridge tower views. At the heart of the home is the kitchen with matching Quartzite stone counters, island and backsplash, custom flat panel cabinetry, Liebherr fridge, Bertazzoni range and Venetian plastered hood faade. The master suite has dual closets and a bath with glass and concrete finishes. As part of the rebuild, the home offers acoustic sub-flooring, four-zone radiant heat, new windows, on-demand hot water and in-unit laundry. Walk to Laurel Village, CityCenter or Clement Street for shopping, stroll to Golden Gate Park and mass transit is a few short blocks away.
